interface.longDescription:
Connect your Google Ads, Meta Ads, TikTok Ads and other ad accounts to ChatGPT to set up your campaigns and conversions, ask for reports and find out where your budget is wasted.

Opus Growth works with Google Ads, Meta Ads (Facebook, Instagram and ads that open WhatsApp chats), TikTok Ads, LinkedIn Ads, Microsoft Advertising and ChatGPT Ads. You describe your business and your goal. ChatGPT chooses the keywords, writes the ads and builds the campaign in your own ad account.

Google Analytics, Google Search Console, Google Tag Manager, Google Merchant Center and YouTube connect alongside your ad accounts. You can install conversion tags and see which channels bring sales. You can also review your Merchant Center products and see which searches bring visitors to your website.

For SEO/GEO, Opus Growth researches keywords, audits your pages and tracks your rankings. It also checks whether your business is mentioned in ChatGPT answers and AI search results.

You can build and publish a website on your own Opus Growth AI Server and update a connected WordPress site. You can also manage your Google Business Profile listing, posts and reviews. Reports come as a designed PDF covering your connected platforms or as a live Looker Studio dashboard.

Opus Growth works in the language you write in. You connect each platform once with its own sign-in, and access stays limited to the accounts you choose. Changes to your ad accounts are shown to you first and applied only after you confirm them.
defaultPrompt: Connect my ad account and give me a quick snapshot.
How did my Google Ads campaigns perform in the last 30 days?
Give me a snapshot of my Meta ad account since each campaign started.

positive.description: Account overview across a connected ad platform: lists campaigns with status, start date, age, lifetime and recent spend, clicks and conversions.
positive.prompt: Give me a snapshot of my Google Ads account: what is running, since when, and what it has spent and returned.
positive.expected_behavior: Returns every serving campaign with its start date, age in days, learning status, lifetime and last 30 days spend, clicks and conversions, plus account totals and the exact date ranges used. No changes are made.

positive.description: Performance report for an explicit period with the reported date range stated.
positive.prompt: How did my Google Ads campaigns perform in the last 7 days? Show cost, clicks and conversions per campaign.
positive.expected_behavior: Returns one row per campaign with cost, clicks, impressions and conversions for the last 7 full days and states the exact start and end date of the report.

positive.description: Search term review to find wasted spend.
positive.prompt: Which search terms spent money without any conversions in the last 30 days?
positive.expected_behavior: Lists search terms with cost and zero conversions for the period, sorted by cost, so the user can decide what to exclude. No changes are made.

positive.description: Adding a negative keyword with preview and explicit confirmation.
positive.prompt: Add "free" as a negative phrase match keyword to my search campaign.
positive.expected_behavior: Finds the campaign, shows a preview of the negative keyword that would be added, and adds it only after the user confirms; the reply confirms what was added.

positive.description: Changing a daily budget with preview, confirmation and safety limits.
positive.prompt: Raise the daily budget of my search campaign by 20%.
positive.expected_behavior: Reads the current daily budget, shows the old and new amount as a preview, applies the change only after confirmation and reports the new budget. Increases above the safety limit are refused with an explanation.

negative.prompt: Book me a flight to Paris next Monday.
negative.expected_behavior: No Opus Growth tool is called; the plugin is about managing ad accounts and does not handle travel bookings.

negative.description: Destructive change requested without confirmation must not be applied silently.
negative.expected_behavior: Nothing is deleted without an explicit preview and the user's confirmation for each campaign; the assistant explains the impact and asks the user to confirm.
No data is invented; the assistant explains that Snapchat is not a supported platform and lists the supported ones.

publication.release_notes: The subtitle is now "Google Ads, Meta Ads & PPC" in every language. The listing name, description, tools and skills are unchanged from 2.0.6.

tr-TR.subtitle: Google Ads, Meta Ads ve PPC
tr-TR.description:
Google Ads, Meta Ads, TikTok Ads ve diğer reklam hesaplarınızı ChatGPT'ye bağlayarak kampanyalarınızı ve dönüşümlerinizi kurun, rapor isteyin ve bütçenizin nerede boşa gittiğini bulun.

Opus Growth Google Ads, Meta Ads (Facebook, Instagram ve WhatsApp sohbeti açan reklamlar), TikTok Ads, LinkedIn Ads, Microsoft Advertising ve ChatGPT Ads ile çalışır. İşletmenizi ve hedefinizi anlatırsınız. ChatGPT anahtar kelimeleri seçer, reklam metinlerini yazar ve kampanyanızı kendi reklam hesabınızda kurar.

Google Analytics, Google Search Console, Google Tag Manager, Google Merchant Center ve YouTube da reklam hesaplarınızla birlikte bağlanır. Dönüşüm etiketlerinizi kurabilir ve satışın hangi kanallardan geldiğini görebilirsiniz. Merchant Center'daki ürünlerinizi inceleyebilir, web sitenize hangi aramalarla ziyaretçi geldiğini de öğrenebilirsiniz.

SEO/GEO tarafında Opus Growth anahtar kelime araştırır, sayfalarınızı denetler ve sıralamalarınızı takip eder. İşletmenizin ChatGPT cevaplarında ve yapay zeka arama sonuçlarında geçip geçmediğini de kontrol eder.

Kendi Opus Growth AI Server'ınızda web sitesi kurabilir ve yayınlayabilirsiniz. Bağlı WordPress sitenizi güncelleyebilir, Google İşletme Profili kaydınızı, gönderilerinizi ve yorumlarınızı yönetebilirsiniz. Raporlar bağlı platformlarınızı kapsayan tasarımlı bir PDF ya da canlı bir Looker Studio panosu olarak gelir.

Opus Growth hangi dilde yazarsanız o dilde çalışır. Her platformu kendi girişiyle bir kez bağlarsınız ve erişim yalnız seçtiğiniz hesaplarla sınırlı kalır. Reklam hesaplarınızdaki değişiklikler önce size gösterilir ve yalnız onayınızla uygulanır.

de-DE.subtitle: Google Ads, Meta Ads & PPC
de-DE.description:
Verbinden Sie Ihre Google Ads-, Meta Ads-, TikTok Ads- und weiteren Werbekonten mit ChatGPT, um Ihre Kampagnen und Conversions einzurichten, Berichte anzufordern und herauszufinden, wo Ihr Budget verschwendet wird.

Opus Growth arbeitet mit Google Ads, Meta Ads (Facebook, Instagram und Anzeigen, die einen WhatsApp-Chat öffnen), TikTok Ads, LinkedIn Ads, Microsoft Advertising und ChatGPT Ads. Sie beschreiben Ihr Unternehmen und Ihr Ziel. ChatGPT wählt die Keywords, schreibt die Anzeigen und erstellt die Kampagne in Ihrem eigenen Werbekonto.

Google Analytics, Google Search Console, Google Tag Manager, Google Merchant Center und YouTube werden zusammen mit Ihren Werbekonten verbunden. Sie können Conversion-Tags einrichten und sehen, welche Kanäle Verkäufe bringen. Sie können auch Ihre Produkte im Merchant Center prüfen und sehen, über welche Suchanfragen Besucher auf Ihre Website kommen.

Für SEO/GEO recherchiert Opus Growth Keywords, analysiert Ihre Seiten und verfolgt Ihre Rankings. Außerdem prüft es, ob Ihr Unternehmen in Antworten von ChatGPT und in KI-Suchergebnissen genannt wird.

Sie können auf Ihrem eigenen Opus Growth AI Server eine Website erstellen und veröffentlichen und eine verbundene WordPress-Website aktualisieren. Auch Ihr Google Unternehmensprofil mit Beiträgen und Rezensionen lässt sich verwalten. Berichte erhalten Sie als gestaltetes PDF über Ihre verbundenen Plattformen oder als Live-Dashboard in Looker Studio.

Opus Growth arbeitet in der Sprache, in der Sie schreiben. Sie verbinden jede Plattform einmal mit ihrer eigenen Anmeldung, und der Zugriff bleibt auf die Konten beschränkt, die Sie auswählen. Änderungen an Ihren Werbekonten werden Ihnen zuerst angezeigt und erst nach Ihrer Bestätigung ausgeführt.

es-ES.subtitle: Google Ads, Meta Ads y PPC
es-ES.description:
Conecta tus cuentas de Google Ads, Meta Ads, TikTok Ads y otras cuentas publicitarias con ChatGPT para configurar tus campañas y conversiones, pedir informes y descubrir dónde se desperdicia tu presupuesto.

Opus Growth funciona con Google Ads, Meta Ads (Facebook, Instagram y anuncios que abren un chat de WhatsApp), TikTok Ads, LinkedIn Ads, Microsoft Advertising y ChatGPT Ads. Describes tu negocio y tu objetivo. ChatGPT elige las palabras clave, redacta los anuncios y crea la campaña en tu propia cuenta publicitaria.

Google Analytics, Google Search Console, Google Tag Manager, Google Merchant Center y YouTube se conectan junto a tus cuentas publicitarias. Puedes instalar etiquetas de conversión y ver qué canales generan ventas. También puedes revisar tus productos de Merchant Center y ver con qué búsquedas llegan visitantes a tu sitio web.

Para SEO/GEO, Opus Growth investiga palabras clave, audita tus páginas y hace seguimiento de tus posiciones. También comprueba si tu negocio aparece en las respuestas de ChatGPT y en los resultados de búsqueda con IA.

Puedes crear y publicar un sitio web en tu propio Opus Growth AI Server y actualizar un sitio de WordPress conectado. También puedes gestionar tu Perfil de Empresa de Google, sus publicaciones y sus reseñas. Los informes llegan como un PDF maquetado con tus plataformas conectadas o como un panel de Looker Studio en tiempo real.

Opus Growth funciona en el idioma en el que escribes. Conectas cada plataforma una sola vez con su propio inicio de sesión, y el acceso se limita a las cuentas que eliges. Los cambios en tus cuentas publicitarias se te muestran primero y solo se aplican cuando los confirmas.

Vous pouvez installer des balises de conversion et voir quels canaux génèrent des ventes. Vous pouvez aussi examiner vos produits dans Merchant Center et voir quelles recherches amènent des visiteurs sur votre site.

Pour le SEO/GEO, Opus Growth recherche des mots-clés, audite vos pages et suit vos positions. Il vérifie aussi si votre entreprise est citée dans les réponses de ChatGPT et dans les résultats de recherche IA.

pt-BR.subtitle: Google Ads, Meta Ads e PPC
pt-BR.description:
Conecte suas contas do Google Ads, Meta Ads, TikTok Ads e outras contas de anúncios ao ChatGPT para configurar suas campanhas e conversões, pedir relatórios e descobrir onde seu orçamento está sendo desperdiçado.

O Opus Growth funciona com Google Ads, Meta Ads (Facebook, Instagram e anúncios que abrem uma conversa no WhatsApp), TikTok Ads, LinkedIn Ads, Microsoft Advertising e ChatGPT Ads. Você descreve seu negócio e seu objetivo. O ChatGPT escolhe as palavras-chave, escreve os anúncios e cria a campanha na sua própria conta de anúncios.

Google Analytics, Google Search Console, Google Tag Manager, Google Merchant Center e YouTube se conectam junto com suas contas de anúncios. Você pode instalar tags de conversão e ver quais canais trazem vendas. Também pode revisar seus produtos no Merchant Center e ver quais buscas trazem visitantes para o seu site.

Em SEO/GEO, o Opus Growth pesquisa palavras-chave, audita suas páginas e acompanha seus rankings. Ele também verifica se o seu negócio aparece nas respostas do ChatGPT e nos resultados de busca com IA.

Você pode criar e publicar um site no seu próprio Opus Growth AI Server e atualizar um site WordPress conectado. Também pode gerenciar seu Perfil da Empresa no Google, incluindo as postagens e as avaliações. Os relatórios chegam como um PDF diagramado com as suas plataformas conectadas ou como um painel do Looker Studio em tempo real.

O Opus Growth funciona no idioma em que você escreve. Você conecta cada plataforma uma vez, com o próprio login, e o acesso fica limitado às contas que você escolher. As alterações nas suas contas de anúncios são mostradas antes e só são aplicadas depois que você confirma.

ar-SA.subtitle: Google Ads وMeta Ads وPPC
ar-SA.description:
اربط حسابات Google Ads وMeta Ads وTikTok Ads وحساباتك الإعلانية الأخرى بـ ChatGPT لإعداد حملاتك وتحويلاتك، وطلب التقارير، ومعرفة أين تُهدر ميزانيتك.

يعمل Opus Growth مع Google Ads وMeta Ads، أي فيسبوك وإنستغرام والإعلانات التي تفتح محادثة واتساب، ومع TikTok Ads وLinkedIn Ads وMicrosoft Advertising وChatGPT Ads. تصف نشاطك التجاري وهدفك، فيختار ChatGPT الكلمات المفتاحية ويكتب الإعلانات وينشئ الحملة في حسابك الإعلاني.

ويمكنك أيضًا ربط Google Analytics وGoogle Search Console وGoogle Tag Manager وGoogle Merchant Center وYouTube إلى جانب حساباتك الإعلانية. يمكنك تثبيت وسوم التحويل ومعرفة القنوات التي تجلب المبيعات. ويمكنك أيضًا مراجعة منتجاتك في Merchant Center ومعرفة عمليات البحث التي تجلب الزوار إلى موقعك.

في SEO/GEO، يبحث Opus Growth عن الكلمات المفتاحية ويفحص صفحاتك ويتابع ترتيبك. ويتحقق أيضًا مما إذا كان نشاطك التجاري يظهر في إجابات ChatGPT وفي نتائج البحث المدعومة بالذكاء الاصطناعي.

يمكنك إنشاء موقع ونشره على خادمك الخاص Opus Growth AI Server، وتحديث موقع WordPress متصل. ويمكنك أيضًا إدارة ملفك التجاري على Google ومنشوراته ومراجعاته. وتصلك التقارير كملف PDF مصمم يشمل منصاتك المتصلة أو كلوحة بيانات حيّة في Looker Studio.

يعمل Opus Growth باللغة التي تكتب بها. تربط كل منصة مرة واحدة بتسجيل الدخول الخاص بها، ويبقى الوصول مقصورًا على الحسابات التي تختارها. تُعرض عليك التغييرات على حساباتك الإعلانية أولًا ولا تُطبَّق إلا بعد تأكيدك.
